brief:
Dozens of mourners in Gaza laid to rest fragmented remains of relatives killed in an Israeli strike during 2023, according to Al Jazeera English. The burial ceremony brought together grieving families to honor their dead as they were finally given funeral rites.

The identities and specific details of those killed in the strike were not immediately clear. Such delays in burying the dead have been common in Gaza, where identification of remains has often proven difficult.
dek: Dozens of mourners in Gaza grieve the loss of their loved ones as they bury the fragmented remains of relatives killed.
title: Gaza buries fragmented remains of 2023 Israeli strike victims
